# Organizations

This area groups the formal organizations, institutions, and administrative bodies that govern, deliver, and monitor ADHD care in Denmark. It covers the regional authorities and geographic regions managing patient pathways, the hospitals and specialized psychiatry clinics providing direct care, and the national databases, governance committees, and professional bodies that establish clinical standards and track quality indicators across the healthcare system.

## Pages

- [[entities/organizations/clinics/index|Clinics]] — Specialized psychiatric clinics operating as distinct organizational entities, such as child and adolescent assessment units evaluated for diagnostic compliance.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-databases/index|Healthcare Databases]] — Central national registers and quality databases, including the primary ADHD database and the national patient register, used to monitor and report on care.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-governance/index|Healthcare Governance]] — Governing and oversight bodies, such as the national statistical agency and central steering committees, that manage data infrastructure and clinical quality standards.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-professional-bodies/index|Healthcare Professional Bodies]] — Professional medical associations and multidisciplinary groups responsible for developing evidence-based clinical guidelines and assessment protocols.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-providers/index|Healthcare Providers]] — Specific regional psychiatric services and private hospitals delivering ADHD-related care, highlighting systemic registration challenges and performance disparities.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-standards/index|Healthcare Standards]] — Technical and knowledge-driven organizations that measure, evaluate, and publish annual reports on healthcare quality standards and ADHD treatment pathways.
- [[entities/organizations/hospitals/index|Hospitals]] — Major hospital institutions and their specialized psychiatric departments providing ADHD treatment, particularly focusing on facilities in the Central Jutland region.
- [[entities/organizations/psychiatry-clinics/index|Psychiatry Clinics]] — Specialized outpatient clinics and departments across Denmark's regions evaluated on national quality indicators for both child and adult ADHD care.
- [[entities/organizations/regional-authorities/index|Regional Authorities]] — Regional administrative authorities and municipal concepts that govern psychiatric healthcare services, tracking diagnostic volumes and geographic disparities.
- [[entities/organizations/regions/index|Regions]] — Geographic and administrative regions evaluated in quality reports, including national-level aggregates and specific regional healthcare authorities managing patient pathways.
